ruleset.name: ThreadLocal Custom Rules
ruleset.description: PMD-TL: lightweight ThreadLocal-specific rules for detecting common ThreadLocal misuse patterns. These rules are intended as a rule-based adapted baseline rather than a full semantic detector.

rule.name: TL_SCO_MissingRemove
rule.message: ThreadLocal value is set but not removed before the method exits.
rule.description: Detects ThreadLocal.set(...) operations in request/task-like methods without a corresponding ThreadLocal.remove() in the same method or finally block.

rule.name: TL_CLP_StaticThreadLocal
rule.message: Static ThreadLocal may retain application-defined values across deployment lifetime.
rule.description: Detects static ThreadLocal fields or static holders that store application-defined values and may cause class-loader pinning.

rule.name: TL_CPM_UnbalancedContext
rule.message: ThreadLocal context is propagated across an async boundary without guaranteed restoration.
rule.description: Detects common async propagation patterns where ThreadLocal state is installed before delegated execution but not restored in a finally block.

rule.name: TL_HVR_HeavyValueRetention
rule.message: ThreadLocal stores heavyweight or growth-prone values without clear bounding or cleanup.
rule.description: Detects ThreadLocal values whose types are likely heavyweight or growth-prone, such as arrays, buffers, builders, parsers, serializers, or compression state.
